trace.question: Among the customers who paid in euro, how many of them have a monthly consumption of over 1000?

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.Consumption > 1000

trace.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.Consumption > 1000
trace.answer: There are 391 customers who paid in euro and have a monthly consumption of over 1000.
